note: Hand-derived expected values for ADR-0001 revision 2; see README.md and tools/derive_fixtures.py. runs: [db, n] finite frames, [db, n, 'clipped'], [null, n] non-finite, ['gap', n] missing frames. 50 ms frames; 48 kHz timing (t_audio_ms = frame_index * 50). Not measurements of any real microphone.
verdict_rule: window_rel_p95 = p95_active_dbfs - session_floor_dbfs; reached when window_rel_p95 >= cal_margin_db - 1, otherwise not_reached; borderline when |window_rel_p95 - (cal_margin_db - 1)| < 1 (ADR-0001 section 8). All 20 cases are valid phrase windows below the band edge, so each expected verdict is not_reached. Revision 2: speech must reach +10 dB to open a segment, so every case has at least one frame at or above +10 dB.

cases.description: Uniform soft speech exactly 10 dB above the floor (the open threshold); calibration margin 13 dB.
cases.derivation: CHANGED from revision 1 (+8 dB uniform): speech that never reaches +10 dB can no longer open a segment and would be no_voice (unscored), not a soft scored window. Floor -60, cal_margin 13, band edge = 12 dB above the floor. 30 speech frames 20-49 at -50 (rel +10.0 opens): 30 candidate frames, onset 20*50 = 1000 ms, active 1500 ms, p50 = p95 = -50. window_rel_p95 = -50 - (-60) = 10 < 12: not_reached. |10 - 12| = 2: not borderline.

cases.description: Soft speech 0.5 dB under the band edge.
cases.derivation: Edge 12. 30 speech frames at -48.5 (rel +11.5, opens). p95 = -48.5, rel 11.5 < 12: not_reached. |11.5 - 12| = 0.5 < 1: borderline. Unchanged from revision 1.

cases.description: Soft speech 0.9 dB under the band edge.
cases.derivation: CHANGED from -48.99 (+11.01): emitted values are multiples of 0.1, so -48.99 would be emitted as -49.0 (+11.0, exactly 1.0 under the edge: not borderline). Edge 12; -48.9 is rel +11.1 < 12: not_reached. |11.1 - 12| = 0.9 < 1: borderline.

cases.description: Soft speech 0.1 dB under the band edge (the closest value on the 0.1 dB grid).
cases.derivation: CHANGED from -48.01 (+11.99): -48.01 would be emitted as -48.0, i.e. exactly the band edge, which is reached. Edge 12; -48.1 is rel +11.9 < 12: not_reached by 0.1 dB. |11.9 - 12| = 0.1 < 1: borderline.

cases.description: A single opening frame at +10 dB followed by softer speech at +9 dB; floor -55, margin 15.
cases.derivation: CHANGED (hysteresis): the first frame is +10 dB and opens the segment; frames at +9 dB then continue it (>= 6). Edge 14. Frames 15-54 = 40 candidate frames: 39 x -46 and 1 x -45; onset 750 ms, active 2000 ms. Sorted: -46 x39, -45 x1: p50 = sorted[ceil(20)-1 = 19] = -46, p95 = sorted[ceil(38)-1 = 37] = -46 (the loud opening frame is the largest). rel p95 9 < 14: not_reached. |9 - 14| = 5: not borderline. Peak -45.

cases.description: p95 exactly 1.00 dB under the edge is not borderline (borderline needs < 1).
cases.derivation: CHANGED (hysteresis): an opening frame at -60 (+10) precedes the +7 dB frames. Floor -70, margin 16, edge 15. Candidate frames 10-53 (44): 19 x -63 (rel +7, continuation), 20 x -61 (+9), 1 x -60 (+10), 4 x -56 (+14). Sorted: idx 0-18 = -63, 19-38 = -61, 39 = -60, 40-43 = -56. p50 = sorted[ceil(22)-1 = 21] = -61. p95 = sorted[ceil(41.8)-1 = 41] = -56. rel p95 = 14 < 15: not_reached. |14 - 15| = 1.00 is not < 1: not borderline. active_ms = 44*50 = 2200, onset 500.

cases.description: A 5 % spike does not move p95: the 4 loudest of 80 active frames are skipped.
cases.derivation: Floor -65, margin 18, edge 17. Candidate frames 15-94 (80): 76 x -55 (rel +10, opens), then 4 x -43 (rel +22). p95 = sorted[ceil(76)-1 = 75] = -55 (idx 76-79 are the spike). p50 = sorted[ceil(40)-1 = 39] = -55. rel p95 10 < 17: not_reached. Peak = -43 (whole window). Unchanged from revision 1.

cases.description: Two words separated by a 400 ms silence (two segments).
cases.derivation: Floor -48, margin 20, edge 19. Word A frames 10-21 at -34 [500, 1100] ms; 8 quiet frames 22-29 (the 6th, frame 27, ends it); word B frames 30-43 at -33 [1500, 2200]. active_ms 600 + 700 = 1300, longest 700, 2 segments. Candidate frames: 12 x -34, 14 x -33 (n = 26): p50 = sorted[ceil(13)-1 = 12] = -33, p95 = sorted[ceil(24.7)-1 = 24] = -33. rel p95 15 < 19: not_reached. Unchanged from revision 1.

cases.description: Long soft utterance in a noisier room (floor -40).
cases.derivation: Floor -40, margin 25, edge 24. 100 speech frames 20-119 at -20 (rel +20): 5000 ms = 62.5 % of 8000, with an offset (40 quiet frames): not continuous. rel p95 20 < 24: not_reached. Unchanged.

cases.description: Word gaps of 4 and 3 frames are bridged: they count in active_ms but not in the percentiles.
cases.derivation: CHANGED derivation (A1-07): speech frames 10-19, gap 20-23 (4 frames at rel +1, bridged), speech 24-33, gap 34-36 (3 frames at rel 0, bridged), speech 37-44. One segment, frames 10-44 (35 frame span), onset 500 ms, end 45*50 = 2250: active_ms 1750 (the gaps are inside the span). Accepted-active frames are the 28 candidate frames, all -52.5 (rel +10.0): p50 = p95 = -52.5. (Revision 1 included the 7 gap frames, which only changed p50 on other data.) Floor -62.5, margin 14.5, edge 13.5: rel p95 10 < 13.5: not_reached.

cases.description: Speech exactly 10 dB above the floor opens the segment.
cases.derivation: CHANGED from the exact +6.00 dB case (below the open threshold now): floor -58, edge 12. Frames at -48 are +10.0: they open the segment. 20 frames 10-29 = 1000 ms. p95 = -48, rel 10 < 12: not_reached.

cases.description: Long soft utterance (6 s).
cases.derivation: Floor -66, margin 17, edge 16. 120 frames 10-129 at -54 (rel +12): 6000 ms = 75 % of 8000, offset observed (30 quiet frames). rel p95 12 < 16: not_reached. Unchanged.

cases.description: Speech that rises in 0.2 dB steps from the open threshold and never reaches the edge.
cases.derivation: CHANGED (hysteresis): the revision 1 ramp started at +6 dB and could not open. Floor -60, edge 12. 100 candidate frames 10-109 in groups of 20 at rel +10.0, +10.2, +10.4, +10.6, +10.8 (-50 ... -49.2). p50 = sorted[ceil(50)-1 = 49] = third group = -49.6. p95 = sorted[ceil(95)-1 = 94] = fifth group = -49.2. rel p95 10.8 < 12: not_reached. |10.8 - 12| = 1.2: not borderline.

cases.description: Speech that decays (loudest first) down to exactly the +6 dB continuation threshold.
cases.derivation: Floor -54, margin 21, edge 20. 40 candidate frames 10-49 in groups of 10 at -42 (rel +12, opens), -44 (+10), -46 (+8), -48 (+6.0 exactly: continuation). Sorted ascending: -48 x10, -46 x10, -44 x10, -42 x10. p50 = sorted[ceil(20)-1 = 19] = -46. p95 = sorted[ceil(38)-1 = 37] = -42. rel p95 12 < 20: not_reached.

cases.description: A loud 150 ms transient (rejected) cannot lift a soft window.
cases.derivation: CHANGED level (was +9 dB, now below the open threshold): floor -60, margin 14, edge 13. Soft speech frames 10-49 at -49 (rel +11): 2000 ms accepted. Frames 80-82 at -30 (rel +30) are a frame-aligned 150 ms transient: 3 candidate frames < 4, rejected, contributes nothing to active_ms or the percentiles. p95 = -49, rel 11 < 13: not_reached. |11 - 13| = 2: not borderline. Peak = -30 (whole window).

cases.description: A 3-frame dropout inside speech lowers coverage but the window stays valid.
cases.derivation: CHANGED level (was +9 dB): floor -45, edge 12. Indices 0-9 quiet, 10-29 speech at -35 (rel +10, opens), 30-32 missing (dropout), 33-52 speech, 53-159 quiet. 157 frames received of 160 expected: coverage 157/160 = 0.98125, emitted 0.981, >= 0.90. The 3 missing frames count as non-candidates (gap 3, bridged): one segment, indices 10-52 = 43 frames, active 2150 ms; the 40 present candidate frames at -35 give p50 = p95 = -35. rel 10 < 12: not_reached.

cases.description: Very quiet room (floor -72), speech 16 dB above floor, margin 19.
cases.derivation: Floor -72, margin 19, edge 18. 30 speech frames at -56 (rel +16): p95 -56, rel 16 < 18: not_reached. |16 - 18| = 2: not borderline. Unchanged.

cases.description: Fractional floor and margin: rel 12.4 against an edge of 12.5.
cases.derivation: CHANGED from -40.01 (which would be emitted as -40.0, exactly the edge, reached). Floor -52.5, margin 13.5, edge 12.5. 30 frames at -40.1: rel = -40.1 - (-52.5) = 12.4 < 12.5: not_reached. |12.4 - 12.5| = 0.1 < 1: borderline.

cases.description: High calibration margin, speech half a dB under the edge.
cases.derivation: Floor -60, margin 22, edge 21. 40 frames at -39.5 (rel +20.5) < 21: not_reached. |20.5 - 21| = 0.5 < 1: borderline. Unchanged.

cases.description: A 5-frame word gap is bridged; the gap frames count in active_ms only.
cases.derivation: CHANGED (level now +10 dB so that it opens; gap frames excluded from the percentiles): floor -58, edge 12. Speech frames 10-17 at -48 (rel +10), gap frames 18-22 at -55 (rel +3, 5 frames: bridged), speech 23-30. One segment frames 10-30 (21-frame span): onset 500, end 31*50 = 1550, active 1050 ms. Candidate frames: 16 x -48: p50 = p95 = -48. rel 10 < 12: not_reached.
